_comment: Hand-curated grouping of the 65 scraped Little Monkey Toes listings into
Shopify products. Written by reading every title rather than inferring
structure with regex: the source encodes the *TOKEN* as the style name for
some vendors and as the colourway for others, and no rule separated those
reliably without also merging genuinely different garments.
`merge` entries collapse listings that are one product in different
colourways. Everything not listed stays a single product. Sizes are never
invented here — they come from tools/seed-options.json, scraped from each
Indices refer to positions in tools/seed-data-real.json.

merge._note: Collegiate is a real Little Monkey Toes category. The axis is a team, not a colour, and labelling it Color would put nonsense in the picker and in the storefront filters.
merge.title: Scarlet & Gold Cheer Dress
The Uptown Baby A+ Sleep Bag

_kept_separate_deliberately.Apple of my Isla BALLET: Go Bag, Backpack, Lunchbox and Nap Mat share a print but are four different products at four different prices.
_kept_separate_deliberately.Bob & Blossom BROTHER: Four different garments with different size runs — 0-3mo for the all-in-one, 1YR/2YR/4YR/6YR for the sweatshirts.
_kept_separate_deliberately.Harding Lane: Each animal design is its own SKU at the brand, and the hat colour differs per design.
_kept_separate_deliberately.Little English: Four distinct garments across two prints.
_kept_separate_deliberately.Magnolia Baby / Mustard & Ketchup / Upto: Big Brother and Big Sister are separate products, which is what the theme's sibling-matching feature is meant to link.
_kept_separate_deliberately.Trotter Street Kids Abigail: Dress, Pant Set and Romper are different garments at different prices.
_kept_separate_deliberately.Widgeon Barn Jacket vs Warmplus Favorite: Different jackets; only the Hooded Barn Jacket has two colourways.

drop.reason: Duplicate Southern Saturday Elephant Dress listing at a different price; keeping both would collide on handle.

_sizeless_note: Bags, nap mats, sleep bags, hats and socks that the source store sells one-size. These get Shopify's default variant so the theme hides the picker entirely.
